scopecontent.p: This collection contains speeches that function as records of prominent speakers and mark the days of Commencement, Muster, and dedications at Texas A&M. This collection covers a range of years as far back as 1877 to 1997. The location of every speech given was at the A&M Campus.

arrangement.p:
This collection is arranged into the following series:
* Series 1, A&M Commencement Speeches. (1877-1997)
* Series 2, College of Medicine Commencement Speeches. (1981)
* Series 3, Commissionary Speeches. (1948-1979)
* Series 4, Valedictory Speeches. (1883-1954)
* Series 5, Muster Speeches. (1946-1997)
* Series 6, Miscellaneous A&M Speeches. (1951-1996)
